name: dataset34v4
description: 34 claims: dataset20v3's 20 plus 14 further claims from the same papers, each scored against only the reference experiments that decide it (hand split, split.json). 14 shared per-subfield norm cards, unchanged.
notes: Each paper's reference was split by claim by reading the paper: the original claim keeps its own experiments plus robustness checks of it; experiments deciding another claim in the paper moved to that claim; experiments that only tune or ablate the authors' method, pure analyses and unquantified demos were dropped (no proposer can be asked for them).
The 14 new claims were drafted with gpt-5.6-sol under make_claims' rules, anchored to their experiments; 6 were hand-edited to remove method/protocol leakage. needs_review: true.
New claims inherit their paper's subfields, so the same cards serve them.
Roles in new claims' references: own experiments = headline (control/confound kept), shared setup = apparatus.
References are model-drafted and NOT human-reviewed; provenance says so and the judge is shown that line.
Cards are per-SUBFIELD: retrieved with queries built from the field name and taxonomy keywords only, never claim text, then served unchanged to every claim in that field.
subfields.json carries 10 hand corrections to the classifier; subfield_overrides.json records each with its rationale, and subfields_original is kept beside each.
